jobs.title: Senior Director AI, Chief Revenue Organization
jobs.description:
Who are we?

Equinix is the world’s digital infrastructure company®, shortening the path to connectivity to enable the innovations that enrich our work, life and planet.

A place where tech thinkers and future builders turn bold ideas into breakthrough experiences, we welcome your unique perspective.

Help us challenge assumptions, uncover bias, and remove barriers—because progress starts with fresh ideas. You’ll find belonging, purpose, and a team that welcomes you—because when you feel valued, you’re empowered to do your best work.

Job Summary

The Senior Director AI, Chief Revenue Organization leads the design, engineering, and deployment of generative AI and machine learning systems across Sales, Marketing, and Customer Success. This is a hands-on technical leadership role responsible for building and scaling production-grade AI systems that directly drive revenue outcomes, including pipeline growth, deal acceleration, customer retention, and operational efficiency. This role will operate at the intersection of AI engineering, enterprise architecture, and go-to-market strategy, partnering closely with Sales, Product, and Engineering leaders to translate AI capabilities into measurable business value.

Responsibilities

Lead End-to-End GenAI and ML System Delivery

Design and deploy generative AI and machine learning solutions embedded in CRM and customer workflows
Build systems including LLM-powered copilots, agentic workflows, retrieval-augmented generation pipelines, and predictive models
Own the full lifecycle from data sourcing and model development to evaluation, deployment, and monitoring

Drive Hands-On ML Engineering Excellence

Architect and guide implementation of model training and fine-tuning pipelines using frameworks such as PyTorch, TensorFlow, and Hugging Face
Build real-time and batch inference systems, embedding pipelines, and vector database integrations
Establish best practices for CI/CD, experimentation, model evaluation, and observability across AI systems

Scale Agentic AI Systems

Design and deploy agent-based systems capable of multi-step reasoning, tool usage, and workflow orchestration across enterprise platforms
Establish reusable patterns for prompt management, tool integration, policy enforcement, and agent lifecycle management

Drive Revenue Impact Through AI

Partner with Sales and go-to-market leadership to embed AI into deal strategy and customer engagements
Contribute directly to pipeline growth, deal velocity, and account expansion
Translate AI capabilities into measurable outcomes including conversion improvement, productivity gains, and customer retention

Lead Cross-Functional Execution

Collaborate across Engineering, Data, Product, Sales, and Customer Success to deliver integrated AI solutions
Translate complex business problems into scalable technical architectures and ensure alignment across systems, data, and workflows

Build and Lead High-Performing Teams

Lead and grow teams of ML engineers, ML scientists, and AI architects
Establish a high bar for engineering quality, execution, and technical depth
Build scalable development practices and delivery models for enterprise AI

Qualifications

Knowledge and Experience

12–15+ years of experience in AI/ML, data science, or distributed systems engineering
8+ years leading ML or AI engineering teams in platform or infrastructure environments
Proven track record delivering production-grade AI systems at enterprise scale
Experience partnering with Sales, Marketing, or Customer Success organizations to drive business outcomes

Technical Expertise

Deep hands-on experience with generative AI including LLMs, prompt engineering, and finetuning
Strong experience with retrieval-augmented generation architectures and agentic AI systems
Proficiency with ML frameworks such as PyTorch or TensorFlow
Experience with cloud platforms including AWS, GCP, or Azure, and modern data stacks
Strong understanding of distributed systems, CI/CD, experimentation frameworks, and observability

Skills and Attributes

Strategic thinker with strong business acumen
Executive presence and influence
Structured problem solver
Systems thinker with enterprise perspective
Builder of teams and scalable operating models
Calm, decisive leader in complex environments
Experience with Salesforce or enterprise CRM ecosystems
Experience building internal AI platforms or developer tooling
Background in SaaS or enterprise software environments
Advanced degree in Computer Science, Machine Learning, or a related field
15+ years experience
Bachelor's preferred

jobs.title: Director, Cloud Platform Services
jobs.description:
Job Information

J ob Title: Director, Cloud Platform Services

Job Requisition ID: 87808

Ministry: Technology & Innovation

Location: Edmonton or Calgary

Full or Part-Time: Full Time

Hours of Work: 36.25 hours per week

Permanent/Temporary/Wage: Permanent

Scope: Open Competition

Closing Date: November 3, 2026

Classification: Management, Senior Manager Zone 2

Salary: $5,139.30 to $6,526.16 /bi-weekly ($134,135 - $170,332/year)

The Alberta Public Service works to build a stronger province for current and future generations. We make a difference in the lives of Albertans through rewarding and diverse career opportunities.

Technology and Innovation is responsible for making innovation and technology the driving force behind Alberta’s economic growth and diversification. To learn more about us, please visit: https://www.alberta.ca/technology-and-innovation.aspx .

The passionate and solutions focused people that we hire help us to drive vital programs and services that affect Albertans. Whatever your position is here, you will be a part of something great. Join us!

Role Responsibilities

Lead The Cloud. Enable What’s Next.

As Director, Cloud Platform, you will provide strategic leadership for the Government of Alberta’s cloud and digital platform services, enabling secure, scalable, reliable, and modern technology solutions across government. You will set the vision, priorities, and outcomes for a portfolio spanning cloud platforms, identity and authentication, messaging, web hosting, and related foundational services.

Reporting to the Executive Director, Business Technology Operations, you will lead a diverse team and work closely with senior leaders across IMT, business partners, and technology vendors to align services with government priorities, client needs, security and risk requirements, and fiscal and contractual obligations. You will foster a collaborative, agile, and innovative culture while ensuring service availability, continuity, and operational excellence.

Responsibilities

Some of the responsibilities of this position include, but are not limited to:

Service/Platform Ownership

Lead the strategy, delivery, and lifecycle management of key technology services and platforms. Manage resources, budgets, contracts, vendors, and service agreements. Engage senior business leaders to align services with ministry priorities and client needs. Ensure services meet applicable security, privacy, legal, information management, and architectural standards. Oversee service performance, escalations, change management, and continuous improvement.

Leadership, Planning and Implementation

Lead workforce, financial, and operational planning to deliver effective technology services. Align priorities and resources across teams and stakeholders. Direct implementation of new solutions, projects, and services. Monitor performance, address issues, and report on progress and outcomes.

Service Level Management

Ensure services meet client and stakeholder needs and agreed service levels. Monitor service performance and drive improvements in service delivery. Contribute to GoA-wide service standards and practices.

Architecture and Standards

Provide direction on technology, architecture, standards, and processes across the portfolio. Ensure solutions align with GoA standards, approved environments, and business requirements. Advance modernization, innovation, and integration of technology services.

Risk Management

Identify, assess, and mitigate risks affecting services and initiatives. Provide leadership on risks related to cost, schedule, quality, security, and technical performance. Collaborate with Cybersecurity and other partners to address technology and security risks.

Unit Leadership and Operations

Develop and execute operational plans aligned with ministry and GoA priorities. Lead staffing, performance, workforce planning, and employee development. Oversee financial management, procurement, contracts, vendors, and service agreements. Foster a collaborative, inclusive, agile, and innovative workplace culture. Oversee executive briefings, correspondence, and other decision-support materials.

Branch and Division Leadership

Provide strategic advice and recommendations to executive leaders. Report on branch plans, performance, and outcomes to support division and ministry priorities. Collaborate across branches, divisions, and departments to advance shared priorities and service delivery. Drive collaboration, innovation, efficiency, and continuous improvement. Serve as Acting Executive Director, as required.

AI Stewardship

This role is designed with an AI-first mindset, requiring the successful candidate to leverage AI-powered tools and capabilities to strengthen stakeholder engagement through automated insights, personalized communications, and enhanced collaboration; create tailored, high-impact materials that align with stakeholder needs using AI-assisted content generation and feedback analysis; and develop, monitor, and refine key performance indicators.

To Be Successful In This Position You Will Demonstrate

Exceptional communication, consultation, and engagement skills, with the ability to adapt approaches for diverse audiences.
Strong political acumen and sensitivity, with the ability to navigate complex and sensitive situations effectively.
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, including the ability to assess complex and competing issues and develop practical recommendations.
Expertise in building productive relationships across the ministry, Government of Alberta, partner organizations, and key stakeholders.
Experience in leading and managing a variety of projects and processes and delivering high quality results within established timelines.
Embraces technology and data by using AI-powered tools and performance metrics to inform strategy, measure success, and optimize delivery.

The Job Description is provided for further details on this position.

APS Competencies

Competencies are behaviors that are essential to reach our goals in serving Albertans. We encourage you to have an in depth understanding of the competencies that are required for this opportunity and to be prepared to demonstrate them during the recruitment process.

Some Of The Competencies Critical For This Position Are

Systems Thinking: You will consider how work completed can impact various other groups/projects inside and outside the Alberta Public Service.
Agility: Proactively incorporates change into processes. Creates opportunities for improvement. Is aware of and adapts to changing priorities. Remains objective under pressure and supports others to manage their emotions. Proactively explains impact of change on roles and integrates change in existing work. Readily adapts plans and practices.
Develop self and others: A commitment to lifelong learning and the desire to invest in the development of the long-term capability of yourself and others.
Build Collaborative Environments: Collaborates across functional areas and proactively addresses conflict. Encourages broad thinking on projects and works to eliminate barriers to progress. Facilitates communication and collaboration. Anticipates and reduces conflict at the outset. Credits others and gets talent recognized. Promotes collaboration and commitment.
Develop Networks: Leverages relationships to build input and perspective. Looks broadly to engage stakeholders. Open to perspectives towards long-term goals. Actively seeks input into change initiatives. Maintains stakeholder relationships.
Creative Problem Solving: Engages the community and resources at hand to address issues. Engages perspective to seek root causes. Finds ways to improve complex systems. Employs resources from other areas to solve problems. Engages others and encourages debate and idea generation to solve problems while addressing risks.
Drive for Results: You will work with your team to set goals and priorities and deliver outcomes that are consistent with the department's direction.

Qualifications

Requirements:

University graduation in a related field such as Computer Sciences, Information Technology or other Technology related disciplines.
Minimum of 7 years of experience in developing and implementing new IT services and solutions in a cloud-based service environment
Experience in a management/leadership position leading high performing technical teams.
Experience in project management processes and methodologies like waterfall and agile.
Strong IT technical expertise and the ability to guide operations and develop strategic roadmaps for enterprise technology services.

Equivalencies
: Directly related education or experience considered on the basis of:

1 year of education for 1 year of experience; or
1 year of experience for 1 year of education

Assets

Experience with IT security, hardware and software, business change, and project management methodologies, including ITIL, COBIT, and PMBOK.
Expertise in Agile methodologies, Lean practices, and Service Design.
Leadership experience in leading teams through innovation, transformation, and organizational change.
Knowledge of government and ministry priorities and the ability to translate them into operational plans and strategic decisions.
Experience in assessing new opportunities and performing necessary due diligence around technical, operational and financial impacts.
Experience working with Identity Access Management, M365 implementations, and Cloud Landing Zone environments.

jobs.title: Director, Application Development - Customer Digital
jobs.description:
Being part of Air Canada is to become part of an iconic Canadian symbol, recently ranked the best Airline in North America. Let your career take flight by joining our diverse and vibrant team at the leading edge of passenger aviation.

The Director of Application Development will lead the design, development, and delivery of some of our most critical customer digital applications and all our in-house cargo applications. Its customer application portfolio consists of aircanada.com’s content related applications (Content Management System (CMS) platform, Homepage), marketing digital assets (Offer Management, DNA) as well as Customer Identity and Access Management (CIAM). Its cargo portfolio includes the cargo website (informational and transactional), the cargo distribution API, the cargo digital backend and all the cargo integrations, a portfolio that keeps growing with the new Cargo Management System implementation through the end of 2028.

This role will also be responsible for the Delivery COE and the Innovation COE for all the customer and cargo portfolios. The Delivery COE aims at harmonizing the delivery practice, KPIs, continuous improvements within the portfolio. The Innovation COE aims at improving our digital technology platforms, through continuous improvements (i.e., progressive AI adoption, Continuous Integration /Continuous Development (CI/CD) pipeline enhancements, etc) as well as disruptive innovations through POCs and partnership with Air Canada’s key technology vendors (i.e., transition to Mono Repo, introduction of a new Model Context Protocol (MCP) stack, etc.). This role is key to our digital transformation journey and will be pivotal in empowering the IDD organization to achieve its cost transformation and innovation goals.

This role will also focus on people leadership, including talent acquisition, training, performance management, and fostering a high-performing team culture.

Responsibilities

Leadership & Strategy
Provide strategic and hands-on leadership for teams building the future marketing and content technology landscape for Air Canada
Lead the cargo deliver teams towards a successful implementation of the new Cargo Management System.
Deliver disruptive technology driven innovations that dramatically increase revenue or reduce cost.
Drive the insourcing strategy by recruiting, developing, and retaining top engineering talent, reducing reliance on vendor-driven delivery models.
Collaborate with Product Owners, UX/UI Designers, and Architects to define the product vision, architecture, and development roadmap.

Technology & Innovation
Oversee the delivery of robust, scalable, and secure digital applications, with a focus on performance, user experience, and maintainability.
Ensure modern engineering practices are followed, including Agile delivery, CI/CD automation, DevSecOps, test automation, and shift-left testing.
Champion the use and integration of Generative AI tooling and AI Agents within the development lifecycle to increase developer productivity and enable rapid iteration.
Stay ahead of emerging technologies and assess their relevance and value for digital product development.
Foster a culture of engineering excellence through code quality, design standards, peer reviews, and continuous learning.

Execution & Delivery
Own end-to-end product delivery, from development through production deployment and support.
Collaborate closely with internal product managers, designers, architects, and quality assurance teams to ensure timely and high-quality product releases.
Monitor team performance, manage risks, remove delivery blockers, and drive accountability for outcomes.
Ensure proper technical documentation and knowledge-sharing across teams.

Collaboration & Communication
Partner cross-functionally with other IT and Digital leaders, including Architecture, Security, Data, and Infrastructure teams.
Engage with key business stakeholders across Digital, Marketing, Loyalty, and HR to ensure alignment between product features and business priorities.
Present technical strategies and delivery progress to senior leadership, contributing to enterprise-wide technology planning.

People & Budget Management
Manage operational and capital budgets, ensuring efficient resource allocation and delivery within financial targets.
Develop and maintain staffing plans, forecast resource needs, and align capacity to strategic priorities.
Support training and professional development programs to grow technical capabilities within the team.
Establish performance metrics and continuous improvement practices for team delivery and application performance.

Qualifications

Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or related field; equivalent experience may be considered in lieu of formal education.
10+ years of experience in digital application development, with at least 5 years in a leadership role managing front-end and back-end development teams.
Proven success in leading digital transformations, including insourcing and adoption of modern development frameworks and practices.
Deep technical expertise in web and mobile application development, microservices, cloud-native architecture, and API ecosystems.
Experience integrating AI/ML technologies or Generative AI into product development lifecycles is a strong asset.
Strong understanding of Agile, DevOps, and CI/CD best practices.
Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to influence across both business and technology teams.
Experience working in or with enterprise-scale organizations, ideally in travel, transportation, or customer experience-driven industries.
Demonstrate punctuality and dependability to support overall team success in a fast-paced environment.

Conditions Of Employment

Candidates must be eligible to work in the country of interest at the time any offer of employment is made and are responsible for obtaining any required work permits, visas, or other authorizations necessary for employment. Prior to their start date, candidates will also need to provide proof of their eligibility to work in the country of interest.

Linguistic Requirements

Based on equal qualifications, preference will be given to bilingual candidates.

Diversity and Inclusion

Air Canada is strongly committed to Diversity and Inclusion and aims to create a healthy, accessible and rewarding work environment which highlights employees’ unique contributions to our company’s success.

As an equal opportunity employer, we welcome applications from all to help us build a diverse workforce which reflects the diversity of our customers, and communities, in which we live and serve.

Air Canada thanks all candidates for their interest; however only those selected to continue in the process will be contacted.

jobs.description:
Department:
Creative

Location:
Canada

Description

Why This Role Exists

Creative is one of the biggest levers in scaling our clients’ paid media performance.

We’re looking for a Head of Creative Strategy to build the people, systems, and operating model that turn creative into a repeatable performance advantage across our portfolio, both in social and display networks.

You’ll lead Creative Strategy and oversee Creative Execution through the Performance Creative Manager, ensuring strategy, production, performance, and learning operate as one connected system.

Key Responsibilities

Who We Are

Clever Digital Marketing is a performance marketing agency helping large home improvement companies across the US and Canada grow through Paid Social, Paid Search, CRO, and strategic advising.

We manage a large portfolio of accounts, an in-house creative team, and significant monthly ad spend. As we scale, we're building a stronger creative-strategy function to help clients find new creative winners — and to turn one-off learnings into repeatable systems that compound across every account.

Skills, Knowledge And Expertise

What You'll Do

Build and lead CDM’s Creative Strategy function, defining the methodologies, standards, and operating system behind how we research, ideate, test, learn, and scale creative.
Manage Senior Creative Strategists and the Performance Creative Manager.
Build systems that turn customer, market, and performance data into actionable creative direction.
Create a cross-account learning system so wins, losses, hypotheses, and insights compound across the portfolio.
Set and maintain the strategic and creative quality bar across the department, regularly reviewing work and challenging thinking.
Ensure Creative Strategy and Creative Execution scale together with the right quality, capacity, velocity, prioritization, and feedback loops.
Build testing frameworks, briefing standards, and learning loops that improve creative performance and decision-making.
Build training, playbooks, and frameworks that improve creative thinking across Media Buyers and Creative.
Build AI-enabled workflows that improve research, analysis, creative intelligence, and decision-making.
Partner closely with Paid Social, CRO, Paid Search, Client Success, and leadership.
Ensure creative decisions are connected to business outcomes such as Creative Win Rate, CPL, CPS/CPD, lead quality, COM, and account growth.
Hire and develop future Creative Strategy talent.

What We’re Looking For

Proven experience leading creative strategy or performance creative.
Experience building or scaling a team, department, or operating system.
Strong performance-marketing and commercial understanding.
Strong direct-response and consumer-psychology background.
Experience building creative testing frameworks, learning systems, and standards.
Experience managing strategists and/or creative-production teams.
Strong cross-functional leadership and ability to drive adoption.
Strong understanding of AI and how to apply it across a team, not just individually.
Able to operate at portfolio level while still maintaining a strong account-level creative quality bar.
Clear, decisive communicator who can simplify complexity and turn strategy into action.

Nice to Have

Lead generation or high-ticket services experience.
Home improvement experience.
CRO and landing-page testing familiarity.
UGC, founder-led, or spokesperson-led creative experience.
Hands-on familiarity with editing or design tools.

What Success Looks Like

CDM consistently introduces genuinely new creative ideas instead of recycling the same concepts and formats.
Creative iterations are more deliberate, strategic, and evidence-based.
Media Buyers and editors produce stronger briefs and creative recommendations on their own.
Learnings are captured, shared, and applied across accounts.
AI-supported research and creative workflows are adopted department-wide.
CDM has a repeatable creative-strategy engine that gets stronger with every test.

Benefits

Benefits of Working at CDM

Competitive base salary + performance-based bonuses
Flexible remote work environment with option for in-person collaboration (Vaughan, ON)
Group Benefits - Medical, Dental, Vision, RRSP/401k Plan w/matching, more.
Company-provided MacBook computer
Home office budget and Clever merch delivery to get you started
Work Abroad Policy: Need a new working environment? Our work abroad policy supports this!
The chance to shape and grow a high-performing Client Success team
A culture of performance and respect where the best work happens with extreme ownership and accountability meets collaboration.

jobs.title: Director of Finance
jobs.description:
Toronto or Waterloo, hybrid | Full-time | Reports to the CEO

Build the finance function at a fast-growing senior care technology company shipping hardware to 24 countries.

The Company

We went from a lab in Waterloo to 24 countries in five years. Our sensors detect falls and track sleep, health and wellness, with no cameras, wearables or pendants. Families get peace of mind. Older adults keep their independence. Our CTO, Dr. Yihong Qi, holds 680 patents, and the next few hundred get built here.

Why now

We are scaling. One of the largest deals in our history is in delivery, our consumer product launches in January, and we are preparing our next raise. Every one of those runs on numbers leadership can trust: a close that lands on time, a forecast that ties sales to inventory and cash, and books that hold up in diligence. This is the moment to bring in the leader who owns it.

The role

This is the senior finance role at Pontosense. You own the close, the forecast, controls and the numbers behind our next raise, across our entities in Canada and China. You work directly with the CEO and the leadership team, and you are in the room with investors. This is a builder role first and an operator role second. You set up how finance runs here, then you run it.

What You'll Own

A monthly close that is reliable and consolidated across Canada and China, landing by business day 10
A forecast the company actually runs on, with sales, inventory and cash tied together
Product costing that is right: landed cost, COGS and inventory planning for hardware built overseas
The raise: the model, the data room and investor reporting, with you in the room
Annual financials prepared and audited on time, and the relationships with our auditors and tax advisors
Controls that hold up across two countries: approvals, spend and intercompany
A seat at the leadership table

What Year One Looks Like

The books close on time every month, consolidated. The forecast is trusted, and inventory is planned, not guessed. Audited financials are current, and our next raise runs on numbers that hold up in diligence.

How We Work

Build it right, then make it better. People's safety rides on what we ship, so we test hard and never settle for good enough.
Say it as it is. Kind and direct, at every level, including the CEO.
Real impact. There is more room to make a difference here than at a company ten times our size.
Do what you said. Trust is built on follow-through, and we return it with real ownership.
Hard, and worth it. What we build keeps someone's parent safe at home. Rest well, it's part of the job.

This is for you if

You'd rather own a problem than be assigned a task
You want the mission to matter and the pace to be real
You're happy to be the person who just fixes it

This isn't for you if

You want a playbook handed to you
You need a big team before you can move

You'll thrive here if

You are a CPA who started in audit, then grew with a product or technology company, with promotions along the way
You have owned the close and built the model yourself, not just reviewed them
You have run FP&A, not only the close: budgets, forecasts and the model leadership makes decisions on
You have worked with inventory, COGS and supply chain costing. Multi-entity or international consolidation is a strong plus
You have worked with investors, a board or lenders, or are ready to step into that
You explain the numbers plainly to people outside finance, and decide with incomplete information
You are as happy reconciling an account yourself as setting the strategy

You don't need to check every box. If this sounds like you, we'd like to hear from you.

Where this goes

As we raise and scale, this role grows into leading a finance team of your own.

What You Get

A sensor for your parents, on us
Direct access to the leadership team. No layers.
Fair pay, with the opportunity for equity
Impact decides your pay and your path, not tenure
Hybrid in Toronto or Waterloo, remote if that's where you do your best work
Health, dental and vision benefits

The details

Pay: $160,000 to $190,000 CAD base salary
This is a new role, created to grow the team, not a backfill
How we hire: typically an initial interview, a short case, and a final interview in person with our CEO and members of the team. We may adjust this depending on the role
We leverage AI tools in our hiring process, but prioritize human input and manual review

Our Commitment

At Pontosense, we are committed to creating a workplace that is inclusive and accessible to all. We value diversity and believe that everyone deserves an equal opportunity to succeed.

If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation during the hiring process, please let us know. We will work with you to make the necessary accommodations to ensure a fair and positive experience for all applicants.

We strive to provide accessible communication and technology for our employees and customers and always look for ways to improve. If you have any feedback or suggestions on how we can improve accessibility in our workplace, please don't hesitate to contact us.

We are proud to be an equal opportunity employer and welcome candidates from all backgrounds to apply for open positions at our company.

jobs.title: Strategy Director, Performance & Creative Integration
jobs.description:
About the role

McCann is seeking a Strategy Director, Performance & Creative Integration to lead strategies that connect brand building, creative ideas and measurable business outcomes. Rooted in our Truth Well Told ethos, you will turn business, audience and cultural insight into clear strategic direction, then work with creative, media, analytics, CRM and commerce partners to bring that direction to life. You will lead client relationships, guide strategists and help grow our clients and the agency.

What you will do:

Lead strategy and creative development

new_jobs.description:

Description

Why This Role Exists

Creative is one of the biggest levers in scaling our clients’ paid media performance.

We’re looking for a Head of Creative Strategy to build the people, systems, and operating model that turn creative into a repeatable performance advantage across our portfolio, both in social and display networks.

You’ll lead Creative Strategy and oversee Creative Execution through the Performance Creative Manager, ensuring strategy, production, performance, and learning operate as one connected system.

Key Responsibilities

Who We Are

Clever Digital Marketing is a performance marketing agency helping large home improvement companies across the US and Canada grow through Paid Social, Paid Search, CRO, and strategic advising.

We manage a large portfolio of accounts, an in-house creative team, and significant monthly ad spend. As we scale, we're building a stronger creative-strategy function to help clients find new creative winners — and to turn one-off learnings into repeatable systems that compound across every account.

Skills, Knowledge And Expertise

What You'll Do

Build and lead CDM’s Creative Strategy function, defining the methodologies, standards, and operating system behind how we research, ideate, test, learn, and scale creative.
Manage Senior Creative Strategists and the Performance Creative Manager.
Build systems that turn customer, market, and performance data into actionable creative direction.
Create a cross-account learning system so wins, losses, hypotheses, and insights compound across the portfolio.
Set and maintain the strategic and creative quality bar across the department, regularly reviewing work and challenging thinking.
Ensure Creative Strategy and Creative Execution scale together with the right quality, capacity, velocity, prioritization, and feedback loops.
Build testing frameworks, briefing standards, and learning loops that improve creative performance and decision-making.
Build training, playbooks, and frameworks that improve creative thinking across Media Buyers and Creative.
Build AI-enabled workflows that improve research, analysis, creative intelligence, and decision-making.
Partner closely with Paid Social, CRO, Paid Search, Client Success, and leadership.
Ensure creative decisions are connected to business outcomes such as Creative Win Rate, CPL, CPS/CPD, lead quality, COM, and account growth.
Hire and develop future Creative Strategy talent.

What We’re Looking For

Proven experience leading creative strategy or performance creative.
Experience building or scaling a team, department, or operating system.
Strong performance-marketing and commercial understanding.
Strong direct-response and consumer-psychology background.
Experience building creative testing frameworks, learning systems, and standards.
Experience managing strategists and/or creative-production teams.
Strong cross-functional leadership and ability to drive adoption.
Strong understanding of AI and how to apply it across a team, not just individually.
Able to operate at portfolio level while still maintaining a strong account-level creative quality bar.
Clear, decisive communicator who can simplify complexity and turn strategy into action.

Nice to Have

Lead generation or high-ticket services experience.
Home improvement experience.
CRO and landing-page testing familiarity.
UGC, founder-led, or spokesperson-led creative experience.
Hands-on familiarity with editing or design tools.

What Success Looks Like

CDM consistently introduces genuinely new creative ideas instead of recycling the same concepts and formats.
Creative iterations are more deliberate, strategic, and evidence-based.
Media Buyers and editors produce stronger briefs and creative recommendations on their own.
Learnings are captured, shared, and applied across accounts.
AI-supported research and creative workflows are adopted department-wide.
CDM has a repeatable creative-strategy engine that gets stronger with every test.

Benefits

Benefits of Working at CDM

Competitive base salary + performance-based bonuses
Flexible remote work environment with option for in-person collaboration (Vaughan, ON)
Group Benefits - Medical, Dental, Vision, RRSP/401k Plan w/matching, more.
Company-provided MacBook computer
Home office budget and Clever merch delivery to get you started
Work Abroad Policy: Need a new working environment? Our work abroad policy supports this!
The chance to shape and grow a high-performing Client Success team
A culture of performance and respect where the best work happens with extreme ownership and accountability meets collaboration.
